nav.title: Flush bleed
nav.description: The same scroll region, `bleed` to the column's real edge instead of boxed in the padding.

nav.title: Full-viewport
nav.description: One column claims the whole row — its scrollbar reads as an ordinary page scrolling.

nav.title: Padded inset
nav.description: The bad pattern — a scroll region boxed inside the column's own padding.
